instruction: Create an SRT file named 'subtitles.srt' in the /home/user/ folder, ensuring it follows proper SRT formatting with numbered entries, correct timestamps, and subtitle lines.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a properly formatted SRT subtitle file named 'subtitles.srt' in /home/user/. Evaluator validates the SRT format by checking for: 1) sequence numbers, 2) timestamp format (HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm), 3) subtitle text entries, and 4) overall valid structure. Progressive scoring provides partial credit for each component: 0.25 for sequence numbers, 0.25 for valid timestamps, 0.25 for text entries, and 0.25 for overall valid format.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.25 for sequence numbers, 0.25 for valid timestamps, 0.25 for text entries, 0.25 for overall valid format

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly verifies all three instruction requirements: sequence numbers, timestamps in correct format (HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm), and subtitle text entries

Metric provides appropriate progressive scoring: 0.25 for each component (sequence, timestamps, text entries, overall valid format)
Logical correctness verified: timestamp regex matches SRT standard, entry parsing handles edge cases (empty file returns all False, encoding errors handled)
